description.zh: 两个开关串联是与、并联是或、常闭是非，真值表由开关是否导通决定。
description.en: Two switches in series give AND, in parallel give OR, and a normally-closed one gives NOT.

zh: 与门 或门 非门

description.zh: 非、与、或、异或都能只用与非门拼出，最少分别要 1、2、3、4 个。
description.en: NOT, AND, OR and XOR can all be built from NAND alone, with at least 1, 2, 3 and 4 gates.

description.zh: n 个开关有 2ⁿ 种样子，8 个开关表示 0 到 255，255 加 1 绕回 0。
description.en: n switches have 2ⁿ patterns; 8 of them hold 0 to 255, and 255 + 1 wraps to 0.

description.zh: 半加器、全加器排成行波进位加法器；进位每多走一列多等约 4 个门延迟，最坏 32 个。
description.en: Half and full adders chained into a ripple-carry adder; each column of carry adds about 4 gate delays, 32 at worst.

description.zh: 减法 = 加上取反再加 1，同一个加法器多一根线就会减；越过 127 与 −128 的缝就是溢出。
description.en: Subtracting is adding the inverted number plus one; crossing the 127/−128 seam is overflow.

zh: 负数在计算机里怎么存

description.zh: 两个与非门首尾相接就能记住一位；S、R 同时松开时会振荡或随机落到一边。
description.en: Two cross-coupled NANDs remember a bit; releasing S and R together makes it oscillate or fall either way.

description.zh: 寄存器加上加法器和时钟就是计数器；时钟周期短于最长路径时会收下错误的值。
description.en: A register plus an adder and a clock makes a counter; a clock shorter than the longest path latches wrong values.

description.zh: 控制线挑选答案；比较两个数就是相减再看 Z 和 C 标志。
description.en: Control lines pick an answer; comparing two numbers is subtracting and reading the Z and C flags.

description.zh: 一台 16 字节、7 条指令的机器，用重复加法做乘法；指令也只是内存里的数。
description.en: A 16-byte, 7-instruction machine multiplies by repeated addition; instructions are just numbers in memory.

zh: 取指 译码 执行
en: how a CPU runs a program

description.zh: 0.1 在二进制里写不完，存进有限的尾数要取整，所以 0.1 + 0.2 得到 0.30000000000000004。
description.en: 0.1 never ends in binary, so it is rounded into a finite mantissa and 0.1 + 0.2 becomes 0.30000000000000004.

title.zh: 真实处理器：规模而非新原理
title.en: Real Processors: Scale, Not New Principles

description.zh: 流水线、先行进位、缓存和多核都是同样零件的更多份；附 2038 年问题等可带走的结论。
description.en: Pipelining, carry-lookahead, caches and many cores are more of the same parts; with takeaways like the year-2038 problem.

zh: CPU 和我们搭的有什么区别

label.zh: 两个常闭开关并联就是与非
label.en: Two normally-closed switches in parallel make NAND

reason.zh: 第 2 章回到第 1 章的接法：两个常闭开关并联就是与非门，再用它拼出非、与、或、异或（最少 1/2/3/4 个）。
reason.en: Chapter 2 returns to chapter 1’s wiring: two normally-closed switches in parallel are a NAND gate, from which NOT, AND, OR and XOR are built (1/2/3/4 gates at least).

label.en: Every column does the same thing

reason.zh: 第 4 章在第 3 章的二进制位上逐列相加：两位加进位，交出和位与进位；8 位加法器用 120 个与非门。
reason.en: Chapter 4 adds chapter 3’s binary digits column by column: two bits plus a carry give a sum bit and a carry; the 8-bit adder uses 120 NAND gates.

label.zh: 加法器全由与非门搭成
label.en: An adder built only from NAND

reason.zh: 第 4 章的半加器与全加器全用第 2 章的与非门拼成（半加器 6 个、全加器 15 个），稳定时间约为最长进位链的 4 倍。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s half and full adders are built entirely from chapter 2’s NAND gates (6 and 15), and the settling time is about four times the longest carry chain.

label.zh: 一根控制线把加法器变成减法器
label.en: One control line turns the adder into a subtractor

reason.zh: 第 5 章复用第 4 章的加法器：B 取反再加 1 就是减 B；100 + 100 溢出成 −56。
reason.en: Chapter 5 reuses chapter 4’s adder: inverting B and adding 1 subtracts B; 100 + 100 overflows to −56.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的 D 触发器由第 6 章那种交叉耦合的锁存器组成；锁存器里一个门晚一拍的设计选择，回到第 6 章的亚稳态。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s D flip-flops are made of cross-coupled latches like chapter 6’s; the choice to delay one gate in each latch goes back to chapter 6’s metastability.

label.zh: 计数器 = 寄存器 + 第 4 章的加法器

reason.zh: 第 7 章的计数器用第 4 章的加法器加 1；时钟周期 ≥ 36 个门延迟时永远数对，其中 31 是加法器最慢的一次改算。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s counter adds 1 with chapter 4’s adder; with a clock period of at least 36 gate delays it always counts correctly, 31 of them being the adder’s slowest recomputation.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的 ALU 包含第 4、5 章的加减法器，再加按位与、按位或和选择器；A − B 时 Z = 1 当且仅当 A = B。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s ALU contains the adder-subtractor of chapters 4 and 5 plus bitwise AND, OR and a selector; on A − B, Z = 1 exactly when A = B.

label.en: The machine’s arithmetic runs through the ALU

reason.zh: 第 9 章的机器把所有算术（包括 LOAD 的“0 + M”）交给第 8 章的 ALU 网络，用 Z 标志做条件跳转；6 × 7 = 42 用 59 步。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s machine sends all arithmetic (including LOAD as “0 + M”) through chapter 8’s ALU network and uses its Z flag for conditional jumps; 6 × 7 = 42 takes 59 steps.

label.zh: 乘法溢出回到第 5 章的圈
label.en: Multiplication overflow returns to chapter 5’s circle

reason.zh: 第 9 章的乘法程序算 20 × 13 得 4：8 位累加器绕过了第 5 章的 256 格圆圈（260 mod 256）。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s multiplication program gives 20 × 13 = 4: the 8-bit accumulator wraps around chapter 5’s 256-position circle (260 mod 256).

label.zh: 有限的位只能表示有限个数
label.en: Finite bits hold finitely many numbers

reason.zh: 第 10 章从第 3 章的位权出发：0.1 在二进制里是无限循环小数，存进 52 位尾数就要就近取整，0.1 + 0.2 比 0.3 的最近值大一格。
reason.en: Chapter 10 starts from chapter 3’s place values: 0.1 is a repeating fraction in binary, so storing it in a 52-bit significand rounds it, and 0.1 + 0.2 lands one step above the nearest value to 0.3.

label.en: Speed is set by the longest chain

reason.zh: 第 11 章回到第 4 章：处理器提速靠缩短最长路径，先行进位就是不让进位一列列传。
reason.en: Chapter 11 returns to chapter 4: processors get faster by shortening the longest path, and carry-lookahead stops the carry from rippling column by column.

label.en: Carry at ten, carry at two

reason.zh: 第 3 章以位值与计数器为基础：十进制满十进一，二进制满二进一，位置决定分量。
reason.en: Chapter 3 builds on Place Value & the Counting Frame: decimal carries at ten, binary at two, and position decides weight.

label.zh: n 次二分对应 n 位

reason.zh: 第 3 章把二分查找列为相关页：n 个开关有 2ⁿ 种样子，正如 n 次二分能在 2ⁿ 个候选里找到一个。
reason.en: Chapter 3 lists Binary Search as related: n switches have 2ⁿ patterns, just as n halvings find one of 2ⁿ candidates.

label.zh: 无限长数轴与 256 格的圈
label.en: An endless number line and a 256-position circle

reason.zh: 第 5 章引用负数页：数轴向两边无限延伸，而 8 位补码把 128–255 读成负数，数轴变成一个圈。
reason.en: Chapter 5 cites Negative Numbers: the number line runs forever both ways, while 8-bit two’s complement reads 128–255 as negatives and turns the line into a circle.
